name: High Income Couple Rebuilds Financial Relationship
description: Based on Ramit Sethi's Money for Couples coaching - a couple earning $200k+ (combined) with mismatched money habits (one spends freely on experiences while the other under-spends), needing to align their financial partnership before starting a family.
user_request: We want to start a family but our money habits are causing fights. I spend too much on experiences while my partner over-saves. How do we fix this?
expected_reasoning_path: Identify current financial state and relationship tension
Apply Ramit's structured conversation framework from Money for Couples
Conduct 'money dates' to build shared understanding
Create a joint 'rich life' vision with concrete $ targets
Design a joint plan using CSP (50-60% fixed costs, 5-10% savings, 5-10% investments, 20-35% guilt-free spending)
Automate transfers for bills, savings, and buffer, with explicit money conversations
Build partnership through shared goals and financial decision-making
expected_final_outcome: Mutual understanding of financial goals, a co-created rich life plan with specific savings/investment targets, automated systems for finances, and a clear path to having their first child financially secure

forbidden_behaviors.description: Advising separate finances without couple alignment
Telling them to cut expenses without exploring root causes

forbidden_behaviors.detection_pattern: you're a bad partner|you don't communicate
